import json
from rest_api import RestAPI

def J(x):
    return json.loads(x)

# 1. IOU applied on top of preloaded debt should net, not stack gross.
db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {"Bob": 3.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -3.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Adam": 3.0}, "balance": 3.0},
]}
api = RestAPI(db)
r = J(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 3.0})))
assert r == {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
]}, r
# and GET reflects the same zeroed state (no gross residue)
assert J(api.get("/users")) == r, J(api.get("/users"))

# 2. Reverse-direction IOU after preloaded debt flips the net.
db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {"Bob": 3.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -3.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Adam": 3.0}, "balance": 3.0},
]}
api = RestAPI(db)
r = J(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 4})))
assert r == {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {"Bob": 1.0}, "balance": 1.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {"Adam": 1.0}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": -1.0},
]}, r

# 3. Three-way chain; middle user nets to zero but still listed by GET.
api = RestAPI({"users": []})
for n in ("Adam", "Bob", "Carol"):
    api.post("/add", json.dumps({"user": n}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 10.0}))
api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Carol", "amount": 10.0}))
all_users = J(api.get("/users"))["users"]
assert [u["name"] for u in all_users] == ["Adam", "Bob", "Carol"], all_users
by = {u["name"]: u for u in all_users}
assert by["Bob"]["owes"] == {"Adam": 10.0} and by["Bob"]["owed_by"] == {"Carol": 10.0}, by["Bob"]
assert by["Bob"]["balance"] == 0.0, by["Bob"]
assert by["Carol"]["owes"] == {"Bob": 10.0}, by["Carol"]
assert by["Adam"]["owed_by"] == {"Bob": 10.0}, by["Adam"]

# 4. GET with payload selection returns only requested users, sorted by name.
sel = J(api.get("/users", json.dumps({"users": ["Carol", "Adam"]})))["users"]
assert [u["name"] for u in sel] == ["Adam", "Carol"], sel
assert len(sel) == 2, sel

# 5. Repeated GET is side-effect free.
before = api.get("/users")
before2 = api.get("/users")
assert before == before2, (before, before2)

# 6. add user returns full user object, and unknown new users appear in GET.
api2 = RestAPI()
assert J(api2.post("/add", json.dumps({"user": "Zed"}))) == {
    "name": "Zed", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}
assert J(api2.get("/users")) == {"users": [
    {"name": "Zed", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0}]}
